status: Six default golden samples approved 2026-11-23 for redraws in the five other styles.

cues: Give each category a distinct silhouette at 96 pixels, including beside a boss emblem.
Use no typography, numbers, actual card artwork, labels, price, card frame or interface overlays.
Any die is an opaque ivory die with dark ink pips, no red or blue pips and no gold or glass faces.
The item is a reward; gold is reserved for the specified prize accent, not a die face or a universal rarity color.
defaults.reference: Use the current theme's approved style-kit anchors. After the default goldens are signed, each matching default may be supplied only as a subject reference for the five redraws.

L1.name: 稀有卡牌
L1.mainObject: three blank fanned cards with a top-center star gem
L1.subject: three blank cards fanned apart, one six-pointed star-shaped jewel set at the center of the front card's top edge
cues: Exactly three card silhouettes; the front jewel reads as six points at small size.
Only the jewel carries a reward-gold accent.
avoid: no large wash of a theme's rarity color
no illustration printed on a card
L1.function: 从三张稀有卡牌中免费选一张。用六角星形识别稀有，换风格只换画法。

L2.name: 附魔卡牌
L2.mainObject: three fanned cards with a round upper-right seal
L2.subject: three blank cards fanned apart, a round enchantment seal attached to the upper right corner of the front card, one small glint beside the seal
cues: The round upper-right seal must stay round and off center.
The small glint is subordinate to the seal.
L2.function: 从三张附魔卡牌中免费选一张。和 L1 共用卡扇轮廓，优先看得出右上圆形附魔章。

L3.name: 牌型精研
L3.mainObject: open handbook, three dice and two rising chevrons
L3.subject: an open handbook with three small dice arranged in one row across a page, two stacked upward chevrons alongside the row
cues: The open pages and precisely two upward chevrons convey study and two levels.
The three dice have dark pips, with no recognizable hand or run.
redrawCues: Copy the approved reference's three top faces exactly: from left to right show 3, 5, then 2 dark pips. For 3 use three dots on one diagonal; for 5 use the four corners and the centre; for 2 use two opposite corners. Keep all three upper faces visible.
L3.function: 选择一个牌型或颜色，直接升两级。不同点数或颜色都不应暗示特定选项。

L4.name: 骰面工坊
L4.mainObject: small bench supporting a die and a file
L4.subject: a small workbench supporting a die, a hand file laid diagonally beside it and a few shavings on the bench
cues: A workbench with a tool working on a die surface distinguishes this from a gift box.
The die remains opaque ivory with dark pips.
avoid: no completed colored, gilded or glass upgrade
L4.function: 可免费改造骰面，最多三次。工坊表示一组改造选择，不指定哪一种改造。

L5.name: 特制骰子
L5.mainObject: open presentation box and a die on a ribboned cushion
L5.subject: an open presentation box revealing a single die on a cushion, a reward ribbon tied to the cushion beside the die
cues: One neutral die is the focus; the open lid and gold ribbon make a gift visible at small size.
All visible die faces remain ivory with dark pips.
avoid: keep the ribbon away from faces
L5.function: 从同点、纯色、镀金骰中免费选一颗。礼盒表示整类奖励，具体候选由游戏中的立体骰子展示。

L6.name: 道具补给
L6.mainObject: open supply satchel with three different items
L6.subject: an open supply satchel with three distinct items protruding from the opening, a stoppered potion bottle, a rolled scroll and a hanging charm
cues: Three distinguishable outlines and a soft bag silhouette, unlike L5's single die in a rigid box.
Keep the potion neutral in color so it does not name a specific item.
avoid: no letters or runes on the scroll or charm
L6.function: 三种各不相同的道具，最多领取三件，数量仍受道具栏限制。
